judgment.notes: The complex exponentials and h are smooth on the compact interval [0,tau]; tau>0, real phases, and the nonzero beta branch justify averaging, FTC and integration by parts with division by tau*|beta|. Symmetry gives the exchanged estimates. In S002 every divisor is positive because the four integer frequencies are nonzero. No E applications occur.

S001 has exact cancellation at either zero phase. Averaging the Lipschitz estimate bounds h and its two endpoints; the derivative integral and one integration by parts give 2|alpha/beta|, then symmetry gives both minima. S002 exhausts the positions of the two largest magnitudes. In the mixed a,c case their ratio is in [1/3,3] by N1<=3N2, and max(|b|,|d|)=N3. The final pair-product cases give respectively 2/N3 and 6/N3. The argument also covers ties. All clauses of N002 follow; no limit exchange occurs.
